Operations strategy for manufacturing plants

We spend the first month on the floor and in the data: throughput by line, changeover time, inventory turns, schedule adherence and the planning calendar. The second month tests the three or four changes with the biggest payoff. The third month writes the roadmap, costs it and agrees who owns each item.

What you get

  • A baseline of the twelve operating metrics that drive cash in your plant.
  • A costed roadmap with owners and dates.
  • A weekly operating review the team keeps after we leave.
